instruction: Candid outdoor full-shot photograph of a couple walking down a rocky path next to a blue-grey marble cliff. On the left, the woman in the white sweater and tan hat (R1) walks downward, touching the marble wall with her right hand while looking toward her partner. On the right, the bearded man in the rust-orange sweater and dark fedora (R2) walks beside her, looking forward and down. The woman and the bearded man hold hands, her left hand clasped in his right. Soft natural daylight illuminates the scene, highlighting the cool tones of the stone and the warm colors of their knitwear.
